blind.description: A stylized rectangular wooden footlocker or storage chest. It features a reddish-brown wood plank texture, a light cream-colored horizontal band encircling the middle, dark grey metal corner brackets, rear hinges, a front clasp secured with a padlock, and thick rope carrying handles on each side. All surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering geometry or missing faces.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangular wooden box top with dark metal caps on the four corners, hinge tabs visible along the back edge, and the top of the front latch visible on the lower edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall), roughly 2.5 to 3 feet wide, and 1.5 feet deep.
